out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed over the counter medicine stored on a shelf over and with food and equipment stored on it in such a way that they could contaminate the food or equipment.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. The PIC moved the personal care items to a more appropriate location during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' The manager did not have a record of employees acknowledging they were aware of the employee health policy requirements.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. The EHS explained the importance of the employee health policy and provided the manager with the FCHD model policy. The manager discussed the form details with the other food employee present, both completed the forms during the inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at wings station is equipped with hot water delivered through a mixing valve. The hot was was 88F upon arrival.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. After running the hot water at the three compartment sink, the water reached 114F. Ensure that hot water of at least 100F is always available at the handsink.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles of sauces and shaker containers with seasonings in them were not labeled at the expedite area.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The manager labeled these items during the inspection. Pizza Hut #37438 (Inspection Date: 09/15/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed a case of single service cup lids stored on the floor next to the proofing unit.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. The manager moved the items off the floor during the inspection.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: grease and debris has built up on the insides of the refrigerator door handles in the pizza making area. This is most likely from employees opening the refrigerator doors with food on their hands while making pizzas and other foods.
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. The EHS showed the debris build up to the manager. The manager said he would get the door handles cleaned.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed the floor tiles deteriorated in the high traffic areas. This makes the floors difficult to keep clean, and can poses a trip hazard for employees which may cause a fall.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. The EHS recommended that the manager discuss replacing or repairing the floor with the owner and/or landlord.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed grease build-up on several walls and ceiling panel surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Recommend a good deep clean to remove visible grease on the surfaces, and then frequent and routine cleaning so that grease does not accumulate again.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The permit was located inside of the office.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM removed the permit from the wall inside the office and relocated to the wall in the lobby, in plain sight, during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink located in the kitchen registered at 72F, initially.
violations.corrective_action: After allowing the faucet to run and waiting for a period of time, the water reached a temperature of 100F, within the appropriate time frame.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: bottles of barbecue sauce, buffalo sauce, cinnamon sugar and margarine at the prep top cooler, and seasonings at the prep counter
violations.corrective_action: The CFM placed labels on the bottles during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The food establishment does have an active permit.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will relocate the permit to the front of the good establishment, in plain sight, for compliance.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided a copy of the vomit/diarrhea clean up procedures to the CFM to maintain in the facility for compliance.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: the dishes in the low temperature dish machine were not properly sanitized since the dish machine registered at 0ppm for chemical sanitizer. There was no sanitizer hooked up to the machine for proper sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM had the food service employee remove the dishes from the low temperature dish machine and wash the dishes using the 3 compartment sink set up. The dish machine was taken out of commission until sanitizer is purchased.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked onions (54F), cooked red/green peppers (54F) and crumbled pork sausage (56F) in #3
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the food items during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There was no chlorine chemical sanitizer test kit for the low temperature dish machine available in the food establishment.
violations.corrective_action: EHS observed the CFM make a purchase order for the test kit during the inspection.
